description: Reconfiguration of the car park and drive thru lane to provide a side-by-side order point, incorporating a new island for signage and reconfigured kerb lines and associated works to the site. Demolition of the existing corral and construction of new remote corral and bin store. Refresh of the restaurant with additional cladding to the roof and the installation of 3no extensions totalling 22.75sqm. The installation of 2 x Customer Order Displays (COD) and a new goal post height restrictor. Reconfigured signage suite with additional signs.
